facts.text: The research used published sources only for every research question.
facts.quote: Each question was researched from published sources only.

facts.text: Roughly 200 to 600 documents per research question were read, and documents supporting the findings were cited.
facts.quote: Several hundred documents, roughly 200 to 600 per question, were read, and the ones that carry the findings are cited.

facts.text: The research ground rules required neutrality across vendors, products and technologies.
facts.quote: stay neutral across vendors, products and technologies

facts.text: The research ground rules required coverage of commercial, open-source, academic and in-house options.
facts.quote: cover commercial, open-source, academic and in-house options

facts.text: The research ground rules required every important claim to be labeled by evidence type.
facts.quote: label every important claim by its type of evidence

facts.text: The research ground rules required every source to be dated.
The research ground rules required reporting failures, limits and evidence against each approach, rather than reporting only successes.
facts.quote: report failures, limits and evidence against each approach, not only successes

facts.text: The research ground rules required explicit identification of findings proven only for road vehicles.
facts.quote: say clearly when something is proven only for road vehicles

facts.text: The research ground rules required writing “not found” instead of guessing a number, price or timeline.
facts.quote: write "not found" rather than guess a number, a price or a timeline

facts.text: The evidence label “Independent” denotes a peer-reviewed study, the text of a standard or regulation, official statistics, a third-party test, or a government or agency report.
facts.quote: **Independent** means a peer-reviewed study, the text of a standard or regulation, official statistics, a third-party test, or a government or agency report.

facts.text: The evidence label “Vendor” denotes a supplier's own claim, product page, press release or white paper.
facts.quote: **Vendor** means a supplier's own claim, product page, press release or white paper.

facts.text: The evidence label “Expert opinion” denotes a practitioner, consultant or industry-group view without supporting data.
facts.quote: **Expert opinion** means a practitioner, consultant or industry-group view without data behind it.

facts.text: Findings proven only for road vehicles are marked “(on-road evidence)”.
facts.quote: Findings that are proven only for road vehicles carry the marker **(on-road evidence)**

facts.text: Transferring findings from highway vehicles to quarry applications is one of the central uncertainties of the heavy off-road collision mitigation validation program.
facts.quote: the step from a highway to a quarry is one of the central uncertainties of this program.

facts.text: Standards not issued by October 2026 are marked “(draft)”, “(under publication)” or “(under revision)”.
facts.quote: Standards that had not been issued by October 2026 carry **(draft)**, **(under publication)** or **(under revision)**.
